{"document": {"aggregate_severity": {"namespace": "https://www.suse.com/support/security/rating/", "text": "important"}, "category": "csaf_security_advisory", "csaf_version": "2.0", "distribution": {"text": "Copyright 2024 SUSE LLC. All rights reserved.", "tlp": {"label": "WHITE", "url": "https://www.first.org/tlp/"}}, "lang": "en", "notes": [{"category": "summary", "text": "Security update for go1.27", "title": "Title of the patch"}, {"category": "description", "text": "This update for go1.27 fixes the following issues:

Update to go1.27.2 (bsc#1272545):

- CVE-2026-56857: os: Root.Mkdir(All) can follow junctions out of the root on Windows (bsc#1284766).
- CVE-2026-56866: net/http: HTTP/1 client connection desynchronization after CONNECT rejection (bsc#1284767).
- CVE-2026-78659: net/http: HTTP/2 server memory exhaustion due to Trailer headers (bsc#1284768).
- CVE-2026-78660: net/http: HTTP/2 transport accepts malformed framing-related headers (bsc#1284769).
- CVE-2026-78663: net/http: double flow control refund on HTTP/2 server streams (bsc#1284770).
- CVE-2026-78667: net/http: lack of limit on size of parsed Range headers (bsc#1284771).
- CVE-2026-78669: net/http: excessive CPU consumption from repeated initial window changes (bsc#1284772).
- CVE-2026-94439: net/http: HTTP/1 server connection desynchronization after 2xx CONNECT response (bsc#1284773).
- CVE-2026-94440: net/textproto, mime/multipart: memory limit bypass when parsing MIME headers (bsc#1284774).
- CVE-2026-94444: cmd/go: checksum bypass for golang.org/fips140 (bsc#1284775).
- CVE-2026-94447: cmd/go: checksum database bypass for golang.org/toolchain (bsc#1284776).
- CVE-2026-94448: html/template: reset context tracking on consecutive template expressions (bsc#1284777).
- CVE-2026-97030: html/template: recognize yield as regexp preceder keyword (bsc#1284778).
- CVE-2026-97031: crypto/tls: reject malformed ECH outer extension references (bsc#1284779).
- CVE-2026-97032: net/http: HTTP/2 server crash due to HPACK encoder race (bsc#1284780).

Changes:

- go1.27.2 (released 2026-10-08) includes security fixes to the go
 command, and the crypto/tls, html/template, net/http,
 net/textproto, and os packages, as well as bug fixes to the
 compiler, the linker, the runtime, the cover tool, the go fix
 command, vet, and the compress/flate, crypto/mlkem,
 encoding/json, encoding/json/v2, net/http, and os packages.
 * go#81084 encoding/json: Unmarshal leaves +/-Inf in the destination on float overflow in Go 1.27
 * go#81145 runtime: mutex profiling can deadlock Windows asynchronous preemption during GC
 * go#81226 runtime: netpoll: eventfd ready for something unexpected
 * go#81229 encoding/json: json.UnsupportedValueError returns an Invalid Value instead of a Float value
 * go#81233 compress/flate: Writer with a preset dictionary emits the dictionary into the output stream
 * go#81252 lib/fips140: fix ML-KEM CAST and re-seal v1.26.0
 * go#81296 cmd/compile: internal compiler error: MoveLoop too small
 * go#81306 cmd/compile: go1.27.0 unified export data loses method order, breaking objectpath, crashing staticcheck
 * go#81324 plugin: loading multiple plugins corrupts stdlib types in Go 1.27
 * go#81353 runtime: Go 1.27.0: SIGSEGV crash with generic function + pointer type parameter + embedded interface
 * go#81362 encoding/json: Marshal now honors MarshalText for string-kind map keys
 * go#81374 os,internal/poll: NewFile on an inherited overlapped stdout pipe hangs a sibling's WriteFile (Windows)
 * go#81389 cmd/fix, x/tools/go/analysis/passes/modernize: errorsastype rewrites errors.As target interface that does not implement error
 * go#81402 os: go 1.25.x regression on RemoveAll for oldest Windows 10 build 10240
 * go#81411 net/http: concurrent response body Read and Close can deadlock with automatic draining in Go 1.27
 * go#81437 runtime: intermittent SIGBUS (unaligned access) in netpoll on mips64le (Go 1.27)
 * go#81469 runtime: ios/arm64 binaries executed outside an app bundle change working directory on startup
 * go#81515 net/http: readLoop reads Response.ContentLength after Body.Close returns
 * go#81516 net/http: Response.Body.Close returns the earlier Read error after a non-EOF Read failure
 * go#81522 net/http: Response.Trailer race due to response body draining
 * go#81580 testing: go test -v doubles ESC (0x1b) in t.Log output since Go 1.27, corrupting ANSI colors in some terminals
 * go#81666 cmd/compile: Embedded interfaces using tail calls cause race detector stack growth
 * go#81667 cmd/compile: go1.27 miscompiles &slice[i].Field on an append-built slice; returned pointer aliases reused memory
 * go#81706 cmd/compile: ICE on 386 when inlining nested bit rotations (Int64Lo not lowered)
 * go#81816 net/http: Request.TLS is not properly populated for HTTP/2 requests
 * go#81818 cmd/internal/obj/ppc64: async preemption bug in BR (CTR)
 * go#81829 runtime: windows/amd64 stack corruption when LockOSThread wraps registry calls (new in Go 1.27)
 * go#81832 cmd/cover: NumStmt duplicated across split blocks, inflating statement coverage
 * go#81861 cmd/go: vet reports no diagnostics for a package that an earlier run vetted as a dependency
 * go#81890 cmd/link: plugin.Open fails on macOS 27: LC_DYLD_CHAINED_FIXUPS seg_count not updated after combining DWARF
